name: The flesh that hates
source:
You are a regular person, you just got home from... Drinking? Doing something else? You can't remember what you're missing so you go to a bar and drink some more! You meet a nice girl and hit it off! but you made yourself too easy of a victim so before you know it, you wake up in her basement and she gives you an ultimatum: get her to like you and let you go before she feeds you to her apparently non-human daughter. What will go down? Play to find out!

[From [url=https://lolhopetch.itch.io/the-flesh-that-hates]Itch.io[/url]]
